svg.title: A movements duration is not its founders lifetime
svg.desc: Modern teaching timeline: the Dagohoy movement is dated 1744 to 1829. CulturEd notes uncertainty about the founders death and says the movement continued after him. The personal death date is left unfilled.

g.text: Movement Dates and a Founders Life
Modern guide / Movement span, not personal birth and death
Founders death date: uncertain in the cited account
The movement continued after its founder.
Do not fill an uncertain personal date with the movements end.
